name: EPIC 247165407
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 10.7 solar radii and 1.08 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,593 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.08 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,677 K at its surface.
